fusions.name: Perfect Form
fusions.desc: Lunges horns-first at a target up to 3 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. The hit always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Practice Stone
fusions.desc: Kicks a stone at the first enemy in its path, dealing 4 damage. It has 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been wounded yet.

fusions.name: Again, Harder
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Footwork Drills
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
